name: Dr Janet Maxwell
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I take a neurodiversity-affirming and gender-affirming approach. Assessment is conducted within a neurodiversity-affirming and gender-affirming framework. Individual adult therapy draws on CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR).
specialties: Gender-affirming, Neurodiversity-affirming, Schema Therapy, EMDR, CBT, ACT, Adult assessment

name: Dr Sarah Pearse
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Sarah is trained in providing EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing Therapy). Services include PTSD & Complex trauma and Sexual Abuse.
specialties: EMDR, PTSD, Complex trauma, Sexual abuse, Hypnotherapy

name: Dr Grace Mackie
title: Clinical Psychologist; Educational and Developmental Psychologist
description: Whether you are exploring gender identity, seeking a WPATH assessment (16+), or navigating neurodivergence. She researched the school counselling experiences of transgender youth. Passionate about autism assessments, LGBTQIA+ support, and anxiety. She is a member of AEDPA and AusPATH.
specialties: Gender identity, WPATH assessments, Transgender, LGBTQIA+, Autism assessment, Anxiety

name: Wren Jablonka
title: Registered Counsellor (Level 2)
description: Especially passionate about working with LGBTQIA+ clients and neurodiversity.

name: Melissa Lay
title: Senior Clinical Psychologist; Senior Educational and Developmental Psychologist
description: Supporting people experiencing OCD, anxiety, trauma, and eating disorders. Uses Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) and integrates neuro-affirming and trauma-informed practices into her work.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, OCD, Anxiety, Eating disorders (ANZAED credentialed)

name: Nindy Brouwers
title: Educational and Developmental Psychologist
description: A special interest in the intersection between neurodevelopmental differences and trauma.

name: Aoife Bearsley
